verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents BugSnag's default grouping (by error class, file and line of the top in-project frame), shows the grouping reason in the error view, and mentions unspecified 'custom options' for tailoring grouping behavior. None of it documents manually merging separate errors into one or splitting/unmerging a wrongly collapsed group. Configurable grouping rules are a related but different control, so they earn no credit for manual merge/split.

support.subject: As a developer, I can merge issues that are really the same bug and split ones the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed
